summary: example for sense 2 in Preterit (Jan 3.17/342)

data.turoyo: Xori ʕAziz, kətle aʕ ʕamayəlani aṭ ṭowe ste w kətle ḥarbe ste. Faqaṭ aṭ ṭowe bəl azyad, bəl azyad maḥ ḥarbe ne. Komanno... hani kulle, aḥ ḥayani diḏe ne, kṯiwile ele w rsimile bu, bu qalamayḏe. W kal komaḥtile, šan d qorənne ar rabonayḏe, kṯəwle haṯe. U mimro di tašʕiṯo daḥ ḥayayḏe yo w fušu b šlomo.
data.translation: Xori Aziz has these good deeds too, and he has bad ones too. But the good ones are more, more than the bad ones. I say... all these are these events of his life. He has written them himself and drawn them with, with his pen. And look, he sets them down so that his masters may read them. He wrote this. It is the poem of the history of his life, and remain in peace.

rationale: First graphic Detransitive result example, contrasting life-events patient with l-actor and pen instrument; full context anchors the subject. English is the supplied project machine translation, not an edition translation; interpretation rests on the Turoyo.
